swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A very fine sieve can separate sand from small pebbles but not two powders of nearly the same fine size. Reason (R): Sieving depends on there being a size difference between the components of the mixture. Choose the correct option.

add.q: Assertion (A): A very fine sieve can easily separate two powders of nearly the same fine size from each other. Reason (R): Sieving depends on there being a size difference between the components of the mixture. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is false, R is true
o: A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): Filtration is generally more effective than decantation at removing very fine solid particles from a liquid. Reason (R): Filtration uses a material with tiny pores that can physically trap particles too small to be removed just by pouring off the liquid. Choose the correct option.

add.q: Assertion (A): Filtration is generally more effective than decantation at removing very fine solid particles from a liquid. Reason (R): This is because decantation uses a material with tiny pores that can physically trap particles too small to be removed just by pouring off the liquid. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is true, R is false
o: A is true, R is false
A is false, R is true
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
